limitations: Bounding-box overlap alone is not evidence of physical collision.

Mesh candidates receive triangle BVH/SAT contact and closed-shell containment checks. Contacts include touching and crossing; no exact common mesh solid-volume assertion is made. Open shells or runtime limits remain explicit unresolved cases.
Part surfaces are tessellated with 0.04 mm deflection for ray intersection.
Finite-beam screening samples the center plus 8 azimuths at 50% and 100% radius; gaps between samples are not certified.
V5 uses explicitly supplied elliptical radii and piecewise straight marginal rays. Focus vertices, beam diameter, M-squared and cylindrical-axis orientation are layout assumptions, not measurements.
TA input is assumed 5 mm by 5/3 mm in 1/e^2 diameter; nominal 1:3 cylindrical and 1:2 spherical reduction gives 5/6 mm round diameter. External TA input is assumed already round with 5/3 mm diameter.
AOM entrance is approximately collimated; the 75 mm cat-eye lens focuses toward the return mirror. There is no f150 AOM entrance lens in V5.
Nominal CAD ray checks do not include RF-dependent diffraction or arbitrary alignment travel. Cable/front access projection and nominal output order separation are reported separately.

AOM root contacts are omitted only inside the measured 3 mm bore channel; each opening and the 1.5 x 2.5 mm active aperture are checked separately. Other expected root housing passages are listed; mounts and knobs remain in the ray checks.
The AOM active aperture is assumed centered on the CAD housing bore; the manufacturer specification is not a measured crystal-to-housing alignment tolerance.
Original platform fastener solids are included as separate assemblies; wrench/tool access is not certified.
Transparent optics are exempt only on their intended centered optical axis; side and rim contacts remain checked. No refraction, polarization, power, thermal or Gaussian mode-matching certification.
UI visibility never removes installed hardware from checks; only explicit installation-mode exclusions do.

orthogonal_paths.scope: All nominal axes must run along board X or Y; free-space crossings are allowed. Segments of a path that declares diffraction_kink_deg (the +1-order axis after an AOM) are exempt when they lie exactly at that angle from the board axes.

The user clamp is interpreted as up to 50 mm transverse to the tail, spanning the 18.328 mm hole pair, by 10 mm along the tail. A 5 mm margin on all sides reserves 60 x 20 mm. Dimensions are configurable.

Each head drills a single rear hole pair at one of the configured offsets (rear_offsets_mm, default 82.7 mm; V9.4 lattice: 54 mm on the output heads, 76 mm on the external input); the reserved clamp footprint is 60 mm transverse by 20 mm axial. merged_runtime_geometry_preservation.scope: All pre-merge input-QWP component geometry and poses compared with a fresh native checkpoint loaded using merged repository code. All 74 optical roots must retain zero translation/rotation and complete mesh topology/vertices plus analytic Shape/DrillPart/SupportPart geometry. Four platform holes also retain exact geometry and positions. This proof supplements the earlier 73-root design revision preservation, whose original native baseline SHA is retained.

existing_assembly_preservation.scope: Actual native root assemblies compared with the committed C1 revision by class, prescribed rigid placement, all mesh vertices/topology and Shape/DrillPart/SupportPart analytic geometry. Cached display-bounds differences require bidirectional boolean identity. Only the twelve explicitly listed input/A/feed roots move; A iris additionally turns 180 degrees. Every B/C AOM and four complete outputs retain their poses and geometry. All four table holes and output tail pairs remain unchanged; the two input tail holes retain X and move -10 mm Y. Input rear offset changes from 76 to 66 mm and is independently proved by the KM05T installation audit. The only additional optical root is Input QWP; its mounted assembly is proved by input_order. Original lattice seat geometry and depth are checked separately by the motion audit.

c1_fr_support_preservation.scope: C1 FR only. Accepted pre-existing edge overhang is retained; new support must not decrease. This is bearing geometry, not strength or a blanket approval of other mounts.
c1_fr_support_preservation.method: Actual horizontal mesh facets at real final plate top, subtract only actual own tap bore, intersect final machined plate; compare same required bearing shape and old/new area.

input_revision_edge_overhang.scope: Added elevated A M1 upper adjustment knob beyond plate; its mirror bearing face remains fully supported.
